tool.name: ANGSD
tool.description: Comprehensive Population Genetics Analysis (GL, MAF, SAF, Counts, Geno)
tool.command:
## 1. Link BAM files with proper .bam extensions touch bam.filelist && #for $i, $bam in enumerate($input_bams): ln -s '$bam' 'sample_${i}.bam' && #if $bam.metadata.bam_index: ln -s '$bam.metadata.bam_index' 'sample_${i}.bam.bai' && #else: samtools index 'sample_${i}.bam' && #end if echo 'sample_${i}.bam' >> bam.filelist && #end for
#if $ref_file: ln -s '$ref_file' reference.fa && samtools faidx reference.fa && #end if #if $anc_file: ln -s '$anc_file' ancestral.fa && samtools faidx ancestral.fa && #end if
## 2. Run ANGSD angsd -bam bam.filelist -out output -nThreads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}"
#if $ref_file: -ref '$ref_file' #end if #if $anc_file: -anc '$anc_file' #end if #if $sites_file: -sites '$sites_file' #end if #if $region: -r '$region' #end if
## Basic BAM Filters -minMapQ $basic_filters.minMapQ -minQ $basic_filters.minQ #if $basic_filters.remove_bads: -remove_bads 1 #end if #if $basic_filters.uniqueOnly: -uniqueOnly 1 #end if #if $basic_filters.only_proper_pairs: -only_proper_pairs 1 #end if #if str($basic_filters.trim) != "0": -trim $basic_filters.trim #end if #if str($basic_filters.c_adj) != "0": -C $basic_filters.c_adj #end if #if str($basic_filters.baq) != "0": -baq $basic_filters.baq #end if #if str($basic_filters.minInd) != "0": -minInd $basic_filters.minInd #end if #if str($basic_filters.downSample) != "0.0": -downSample $basic_filters.downSample #end if
## Genotype Likelihoods #if str($gl_sec.gl) != "0": -GL $gl_sec.gl #end if #if str($gl_sec.doGlf) != "0": -doGlf $gl_sec.doGlf #end if
## Counts and Depths #if str($counts_sec.doCounts) != "0": -doCounts $counts_sec.doCounts #if str($counts_sec.dumpCounts) != "0": -dumpCounts $counts_sec.dumpCounts #end if #if str($counts_sec.iCounts) != "0": -iCounts $counts_sec.iCounts #end if #if str($counts_sec.setMaxDepth) != "-1": -setMaxDepth $counts_sec.setMaxDepth #end if #if str($counts_sec.setMinDepth) != "-1": -setMinDepth $counts_sec.setMinDepth #end if #end if
#if str($counts_sec.doDepth) != "0": -doDepth $counts_sec.doDepth -maxDepth $counts_sec.maxDepth #end if
## Association Studies #if str($asso_sec.doAsso) != "0": -doAsso $asso_sec.doAsso #if $asso_sec.yBin: -yBin '$asso_sec.yBin' #end if #if $asso_sec.yCount: -yCount '$asso_sec.yCount' #end if #if $asso_sec.yQuant: -yQuant '$asso_sec.yQuant' #end if #if $asso_sec.cov: -cov '$asso_sec.cov' #end if -model $asso_sec.model #if $asso_sec.pvalue: -Pvalue 1 #end if #end if
## Allele Frequencies & Posteriors #if str($maf_sec.doMaf) != "0": -doMaf $maf_sec.doMaf #if str($maf_sec.doPost) != "0": -doPost $maf_sec.doPost #end if #if str($maf_sec.minMaf) != "-1.0": -minMaf $maf_sec.minMaf #end if #if str($maf_sec.SNP_pval) != "1.0": -SNP_pval $maf_sec.SNP_pval #end if #if str($maf_sec.rmTriallelic) != "0.0": -rmTriallelic $maf_sec.rmTriallelic #end if #if $maf_sec.skipMissing: -skipMissing 1 #end if #end if #if $maf_sec.forceMaf and (str($maf_sec.doMaf) != "0" or str($asso_sec.doAsso) != "0"): -forceMaf 1 #end if
## SAF (Site Frequency Spectrum) #if str($saf_sec.doSaf) != "0": -doSaf $saf_sec.doSaf #if $saf_sec.isHap: -isHap 1 #end if #if $saf_sec.noTrans: -noTrans 1 #end if #if $saf_sec.underFlowProtect: -underFlowProtect 1 #end if -scoreTol $saf_sec.scoreTol #end if
## Genotype Calling #if str($geno_sec.geno_cond.enable_geno) == 'yes': #if str($geno_sec.geno_cond.doGeno) != "0": -doGeno $geno_sec.geno_cond.doGeno #if str($geno_sec.geno_cond.doPlink) != "0": -doPlink $geno_sec.geno_cond.doPlink #end if #end if -postCutoff $geno_sec.geno_cond.postCutoff #end if
## Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium #if str($hwe_sec.doHWE) != "0": -doHWE $hwe_sec.doHWE #if str($hwe_sec.minHWEpval) != "-1.0": -minHWEpval $hwe_sec.minHWEpval #end if #if str($hwe_sec.maxHWEpval) != "-1.0": -maxHWEpval $hwe_sec.maxHWEpval #end if #if str($hwe_sec.maxHetFreq) != "-1.0": -maxHetFreq $hwe_sec.maxHetFreq #end if #if str($hwe_sec.minHetFreq) != "-1.0": -minHetFreq $hwe_sec.minHetFreq #end if #end if
## Major/Minor Alleles #if str($majorminor_sec.doMajorMinor) != "0": -doMajorMinor $majorminor_sec.doMajorMinor #if $majorminor_sec.rmTrans: -rmTrans 1 #end if #if $majorminor_sec.skipTriallelic: -skipTriallelic 1 #end if #end if
## Other #if str($other_sec.doError) != "0": -doError $other_sec.doError #end if #if str($other_sec.doAncError) != "0": -doAncError $other_sec.doAncError #end if #if str($other_sec.doFasta) != "0": -doFasta $other_sec.doFasta #end if #if str($other_sec.doAbbababa) != "0": -doAbbababa $other_sec.doAbbababa #end if #if str($other_sec.doHaploCall) != "0": -doHaploCall $other_sec.doHaploCall #end if #if $other_sec.doHetPlas: -doHetPlas 1 #end if

param.name: input_bams
param.label: Input BAM file(s)
param.help: Select one or more coordinate-sorted BAM files.

param.name: ref_file
param.label: Reference Genome (FASTA)
param.help: Required for GL=1 (SAMtools), major/minor inference modes 4 and 7, and error estimation. Not needed for all analyses.

param.name: anc_file
param.label: Ancestral Genome (FASTA)
param.help: Required for -anc-based error estimation, SAF, ABBA-BABA, and major/minor inference mode 5. Not needed for all analyses.

param.name: sites_file
param.label: Sites File (-sites)
param.help: File containing sites to keep; required for major/minor inference mode 3.

param.name: region
param.label: Region
param.help: Target region for analysis (specify as CHROM:START-END).

validator.message: Region format must be like 'chr' or 'chr:start-end'

param.label: Minimum Mapping Quality
param.help: Discard reads with mapping quality below this threshold.

param.label: Minimum Base Quality
param.help: Discard bases with quality below this threshold.

param.label: Remove Bad Reads
param.help: Discard reads with FLAG 512.

param.label: Unique Mapping Only
param.help: Discards reads that don't map uniquely.

param.label: Proper Pairs Only
param.help: Only use reads where the mate could be mapped.

param.label: Trim bases
param.help: Number of bases to discard at both ends of the reads.

param.name: c_adj
param.label: Adjust MapQ for excessive mismatches
param.help: Like SAMtools -C. Requires Reference Genome.

param.label: Base Alignment Quality (BAQ)
param.help: Requires Reference Genome.

param.label: Minimum Individuals
param.help: Discard site if data is present in fewer than this many individuals (0 = no filtering).

param.label: Downsample fraction
param.help: Downsample to the fraction of original data.

param.label: Max Depth Binning
param.help: Bin together high depths for doDepth distribution.

param.label: Global Min Depth Filter
param.help: If total depth is smaller, site is removed (-1 disables).

param.label: Global Max Depth Filter
param.help: If total depth is larger, site is removed (-1 disables).

param.label: Perform Association Study
param.option: 5: Score Test with latent genotype model

param.label: Disease Status File (-yBin)
param.help: File containing binary disease status.

param.label: Count Phenotypes (-yCount)
param.help: File containing count quantitative phenotypes.

param.label: Phenotypes (-yQuant)
param.help: File containing quantitative phenotypes.

param.label: Covariates File (-cov)
param.help: File containing additional covariates.

param.name: pvalue
param.label: Print P-value instead of likelihood ratio
Min MAF Filter
param.help: Remove sites with MAF below this value (-1 to disable).

param.label: SNP p-value threshold
param.help: Remove sites with p-value larger than this.

param.label: Remove Triallelic threshold
param.help: Remove sites with p-value lower than this.

param.label: Force MAF Output
param.help: Write .mafs file when running -doAsso.

param.label: Skip Missing
param.help: Set postCutoff to 0.33 if missing (do not use frequency as prior).

section.name: saf_sec
section.title: 6. Site Frequency Spectrum (-doSaf)
section.help: -doSaf requires an Ancestral Genome (-anc) to be provided.

param.label: Estimate SAF
param.option: 3: Calculate genotype probabilities using SAF (DEPRECATED; use -doPost 3)

param.label: Samples are Haploid
param.help: Works with -doSaf 1 or 5

param.label: Score Tolerance
param.help: Tolerance for score-limited algorithm.

param.label: Call Genotypes (-doGeno)
param.help: Additive options: 1 (major/minor), 2 (genotype -1,0,1,2), 4 (AA, AC), 8 (posterior prob all), 16 (posterior prob called). Example: enter 3 for options 1+2. (0 to disable).

param.label: Posterior Cutoff
param.help: Set genotype to missing if below this threshold.

param.label: Minimum HWE p-value
param.help: Minimum Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium p-value threshold. Set to -1.0 to disable filtering.

param.label: Maximum HWE p-value
param.help: Maximum Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium p-value threshold. Set to -1.0 to disable filtering.

param.label: Minimum Heterozygosity Frequency
param.help: Minimum allowed frequency of heterozygotes. Set to -1.0 to disable filtering.

param.label: Maximum Heterozygosity Frequency
param.help: Maximum allowed frequency of heterozygotes. Set to -1.0 to disable filtering.

param.label: Infer Major/Minor
param.option: 3: Use major and minor from a file (requires -sites file.txt)
6: Use EBD for major and minor (requires read data)
7: Use EBD for minor (Major is ref) (requires -ref and read data)

param.label: Estimate type specific error rates (-doError)
param.help: -doError 1 requires -doMajorMinor 2.

param.label: Estimate error rate based on perfect fastas (-doAncError)
param.help: Requires both Reference (-ref) and Ancestral (-anc) Genomes.

param.label: Generate FASTA (-doFasta)
param.help: -doFasta modes 1 and 2 require -doCounts 1 in the Counts section.

param.label: Haploid Calling (-doHaploCall)
param.help: Must choose -doCounts 1.

param.label: Estimate Hetplasmy (-doHetPlas)
param.help: Estimate hetplasmy by calculating a pooled haploid frequency

data.name: output_mafs
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: Allele Frequencies (.mafs.gz)
data.filter: maf_sec['doMaf'] != "0" or (maf_sec['forceMaf'] is True and asso_sec['doAsso'] != "0")

data.name: output_glf
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: Binary/Text GLF (.glf.gz)
data.filter: gl_sec['doGlf'] == "1" or gl_sec['doGlf'] == "3" or gl_sec['doGlf'] == "4" or gl_sec['doGlf'] == "5"

tool.help:
**ANGSD (Analysis of Next Generation Sequencing Data)** is a comprehensive software for analyzing DNA data, highly optimized for low-coverage and ancient DNA.
Unlike normal tools that force exact genotype calling (which causes massive errors in low-depth data), ANGSD utilizes Genotype Likelihoods and posterior probabilities to compute population genetics statistics mathematically.
**Core Capabilities Included in this Wrapper:** * **Genotype Likelihoods (GL)**: Estimate GLs using SAMtools, GATK, or SOAPsnp models. * **Allele Frequencies (MAF)**: Estimate frequencies without relying on strict genotype calls. * **Site Frequency Spectrum (SAF)**: Calculate Multi-dimensional SFS, crucial for demographic inference (realSFS). * **Genotype Calling**: Extract exact bases or probabilties, with direct export to PLINK. * **Association Studies**: Perform score and frequency tests natively. * **Depths & Counts**: Direct read counting, contamination prep (`.icnts`), and depth distributions. * **Other Tools**: Error rate estimations, ABBA-BABA tests, Fasta consensus generation.
**Input Requirements:** * **Input BAM file(s):** One or more coordinate-sorted BAM files. * **Reference Genome (FASTA):** Optional. Required for GL=1 (SAMtools), major/minor inference modes 4 and 7, and error estimation. * **Ancestral Genome (FASTA):** Optional. Required for -anc-based error estimation, SAF, ABBA-BABA, and major/minor inference mode 5. * **Sites File:** Optional. Tabular/text file containing specific sites to keep. Required for major/minor inference mode 3. * **Region:** Optional. Target region for analysis specified as CHROM:START-END. * **Phenotype Files:** Optional. (`-yBin`, `-yCount`, `-yQuant`, `-cov`) files required for association studies.
**Outputs** Depending on the selected modules and parameters, ANGSD can produce a wide variety of outputs: * **Counts:** Internal Counts (`.icnts.gz`), Dumped Positions (`.pos.gz`), Dumped Counts (`.counts.gz`), Global Depth, and Sample Depth. * **Allele Frequencies:** Allele Frequencies (`.mafs.gz`). * **Genotype Likelihoods:** Beagle Likelihoods (`.beagle.gz`) and Binary/Text GLF (`.glf.gz`). * **Site Frequency Spectrum (SAF):** SAF index (`.saf.idx`), positions (`.saf.pos.gz`), and data (`.saf.gz`). * **Genotype Calling:** Genotypes (`.geno.gz`), along with PLINK `.tped` and `.tfam` formats. * **Association Studies:** Association LRT (`.lrt0.gz`) and Association Beta (`.asso.gz`). * **Population Genetics & Other Stats:** HWE (`.hwe.gz`), HaploCall (`.haplo.gz`), Error Rates (`.err.gz`), Ancestral Error (`.ancError`), HetPlasmy (`.hetPlas`), Fasta Output (`.fa.gz`), and ABBA-BABA Stats (`.abbababa`).
**Important Note on Filters**: ANGSD strongly relies on hierarchical dependencies. For example, Genotype Likelihoods (`-GL`) or Counts (`-doCounts`) MUST be enabled for most downstream analyses (like `-doMaf`, `-doSaf`, `-doGeno`). Be sure to configure the upstream data sections properly when activating an analysis module.
Please refer to the official website "http://www.popgen.dk/angsd" for deep theoretical reference on each flag.
